Charcoal Tile Bathroom Remodel

A modern Davie bathroom remodel featuring large-format charcoal tile, a frameless glass shower, rainfall fixtures and a clean monochrome palette.

LocationDavie, Florida
Project TypeComplete Bathroom Remodel
Design StyleModern Minimalist
Featured FinishLarge-Format Charcoal Tile
Project Overview

Designed for calm, comfort and everyday use.

This Davie bathroom remodel uses oversized charcoal tile and clear glass to create a sleek, architectural shower environment.

Large-format dark wall tile minimizes grout lines and gives the shower a strong contemporary character. A frameless glass enclosure preserves openness, while chrome controls, a rainfall shower head and a built-in bench add everyday comfort. White fixtures and flooring balance the deeper wall tones for a clean monochrome finish.

Wall TileLarge-format charcoal porcelain tile
ShowerFrameless glass enclosure with built-in bench
FixturesChrome rainfall and handheld shower system
PaletteCharcoal, white and polished metal
Design Highlights

Purposeful materials. Refined details.

Large-Format Tile

Oversized tile creates broad uninterrupted surfaces with fewer visible grout joints.

Frameless Glass

Clear panels keep the room open while defining the shower zone.

Rainfall Shower

A ceiling-style rainfall head supports a more relaxing shower experience.

Integrated Bench

The built-in seat adds comfort without interrupting the minimalist composition.

Monochrome Contrast

Deep charcoal walls are balanced by white flooring and fixtures.

Clean Chrome Details

Polished hardware introduces a precise, contemporary finish.
